title: Gas Grenade Pathfinder Build Guide: Poison Clouds, Boss Pre-lay and Gear
summary: 0.5.4 poison-cloud toolkit: Gas Grenade spawns and overlaps Poison Clouds, stacking via Despair / Toxic Domain / Wither. Covers poison-duration breakpoints, boss pre-lay, Ghost Dance and Evasion boundaries.
description: Path of Exile 2 Gas Grenade Pathfinder guide for 0.5.4: cloud stacking, duration breakpoints, boss pre-lay order, defense boundaries and real video timestamps.
author: Exile2 Guides Editorial Team
imageAlt: Ranger Pathfinder lobbing Gas Grenade to spread a Poison Cloud on the ground in combat

sections.title: Build Overview
paragraphs: Gas Grenade Pathfinder is the Ranger poison-cloud toolkit: Gas Grenade spawns a Poison Cloud at the impact point, and overlapping grenades enlarge the cloud and its stacks. The Pathfinder ascendancy boosts damage-over-time and flask/ground effects, making the cloud the main output.

The key is not 'throw accurately' but 'pre-lay'. In bossing you lay the cloud before the boss arrives, then pile stacks with Despair / Toxic Domain / Wither. Mapping covers packs with continuous throws.

Too-short Poison Duration makes the boss health bar dip then stall — the most common 'weak single-target' root cause. This guide explains duration breakpoints and pre-lay order, with all client numbers flagged for PC verification.
bullets: Gas Grenade spawns overlapping Poison Clouds.
Pathfinder boosts DoT and flask/ground effects.
Weak bossing usually comes from Poison Duration, not gear.

sections.title: Pros and Cons
pros: Clouds auto-deal DoT; mapping barely needs aiming.
Stacking makes the boss health bar slide steadily.
Pathfinder flask/ground buffs add error margin.
Low budget already maps and bosses most content.
cons: Too-short Poison Duration stalls and single-target looks weak.
Moving targets (e.g. flying bosses) lower cloud coverage.
Chaos Res and ES recovery are hard late-game needs.
Pre-lay rhythm needs practice; random throws waste output.

sections.title: How the Loop Reads: Pre-lay Clouds
paragraphs: Mapping loop: throw Gas Grenade continuously at packs so clouds overlap; you just position yourself outside the cloud and mobs inside.
Boss loop: pre-lay 1–2 clouds before the boss reaches the spot, then Despair for res reduction, Toxic Domain for stacks, Wither to amplify. Dark Effigy can add a persistent cloud layer.
Cloud spread is an area effect, not a projectile; laying it where the enemy will be matters more than aiming at the enemy.
bullets: Boss = pre-lay → Despair → Toxic Domain → Wither.
Cloud is ground effect; pre-lay beats aiming.

steps.label: Levels 1–14
body: Map with a basic bow/crossbow skill; Gas Grenade is a filler once unlocked, stacks not yet formed.

steps.label: Levels 15–29
body: Take Gas Grenade and start stacking clouds; add life/evasion/Chaos Res nodes.

steps.label: Levels 30–42 — Pathfinder Unlocks
body: Pick Pathfinder, boost DoT and ground effects; boss pre-lay stabilizes.

steps.label: Levels 43–60 — Early Maps
body: Run the cloud loop on low budget; add Despair / Toxic Domain links, fix resistances.

steps.label: Pathfinder — First Nodes
body: Prioritize nodes boosting DoT and ground/flask effects; this is the base of the cloud toolkit.

steps.label: Defense Check
body: If dying at T15+, add Evasion / ES / Ghost Dance nodes; do not trade all for damage.

steps.label: Campaign

sections.title: Mapping
paragraphs: Throw Gas Grenade continuously at packs so clouds overlap; keep yourself outside the cloud and mobs inside, roll to reposition.
Trash does not need Despair; only rares/bosses get res reduction and stacks. When clear slows, upgrade the throwing base before stacking defense.
bullets: Upgrade throwing base first when clear slows.

sections.title: Bossing
paragraphs: Pre-lay 1–2 clouds before the boss reaches the spot, then Despair for res reduction, Toxic Domain for stacks, Wither to amplify, Dark Effigy for an extra layer.
If the bar stalls, the issue is Poison Duration / re-throw frequency, not gear. Moving bosses need clouds laid ahead of their path, not chased.
bullets: Dark Effigy adds a cloud layer.
Stall = fix duration, not swap weapon.

sections.title: Poison Duration Breakpoints
paragraphs: Poison Duration decides how long a stack persists on the target. Too short makes the boss bar stop sliding after stacks expire, creating a false 'weak single-target' impression.
Raise it via support duration mods, Toxic Domain's buff, duration/area mods on gear, and Pathfinder's ground-effect nodes. Exact numbers pending PC verification; verify in client.
bullets: Duration/area mods and Toxic Domain extend together.
